task.arithmetic: Exact raw UTF-8 match on the captured argument
task.ordering: source order for matrices; canonical set order for sets
task.ownership: borrowed observations remain valid until next turn; retained snapshots must preserve earlier values
task.state: First turn suspends without publication; next turn resumes using original capture despite changed live input
task.effects: Pure FSM: no external effects permitted; effectful FSM coverage is a separate case

measurement.output_observation: named result borrowed after timed block; owned snapshot timed separately
measurement.setup: catalog, compilation, encoding, decoding, activation, and warmup excluded from turn
measurement.reset: fresh instance after warmup; state evolves within each block
measurement.destruction: instance and returned owned snapshots excluded; teardown separately timed
measurement.cache: warm process; fresh activation per fork; OS caches uncontrolled
